notes.title: Daily special offer is now open! "Idle Devils" has reached a new low! !
"Idle Devils" is about to receive a major update!
notes.content:
All players can permanently unlock this character in the new version releasing next Wednesday morning (May 21st)!

The skin for [Shadowborn·Sarah] will also be FREE for everyone! All players can permanently obtain it in the new version releasing next Wednesday morning (May 21st)!

The update for "Idle Devils" has been mostly completed, including the rework of the Leviathan set and various bug fixes. The new version will officially launch next Wednesday morning (May 21st)!

Additionally, we have exciting news: Our team is currently developing a pure-blood dark fantasy action game (name pending, hehe). This new project is being created by the original teams behind "Idle Devils" and "EndlessJourney". While retaining the strengths of our previous works, it completely revolutionizes traditional idle gameplay and presentation. It will be a unique and highly anticipated adventure!

Join our fan QQ group: 297937881 to participate in discussions. We'll periodically share development progress in the group - come monitor our progress! We sincerely hope for your continued support. Thank you all!!!

notes.title: 《Update!! The dress-up system is now online!!》
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315441/e7c92feeb4b8f0dbab7b5688d53285faecfc1c63.png
【Clothes changing system is now available】

*. Added a new clothes changing system. Click the "rabbit ears" button in the character or team interface to select clothes;
*. Added a new clothing series: [Shadowborn], including 3 sets of character costumes;
*. Added a new DLC costume: Shadowborn-Sarah (costume); [Under review]
*. Added a new DLC costume: Shadowborn-Beelzebub (costume);
*. Added a new DLC costume: Shadowborn: Asmodeus (costume);

 They include a new set of dynamic portraits, combat roles, combat performances, etc. 

 Congratulations on the second anniversary of "Idle Devils"! ! In order to thank everyone for their long-term support, we will release a new welfare event in the official QQ group 590796675. We hope everyone will actively participate! !

In addition, another idle immortal cultivation game [无休仙途] created by our original team has also ushered in major updates of magic weapons and difficult modes. Brothers who like to cultivate immortals and brush treasures and hang up can support it! Thank you all! ! 

Beelzebub (clothing): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468070/_/

Asmodeus (clothing): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3212210/_/

Endless Immortal Path: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654540/_/

Finally, I wish you all the best in the new year!

notes.content:
【Add content】
*. Added a brand-new dungeon challenge: [Devil King's Trial], which will be opened after clearing levels 1-24. Participating in the challenge will get a lot of rewards!
*. Added a brand new prop item: mark, which is used to open the trial of the devil. Different marks open different trials, and marks can be obtained through mainline level challenges!
*. New phantoms have been added. They appear in the Demon King Trial. Defeating the corresponding phantoms can obtain the exclusive equipment of the character!
*. Added a new set system, defeating the corresponding phantom has a chance to get the corresponding set!
*. Added 4 brand new maps, they appear in the trial of the devil, fight in each map, you can get the exclusive rewards of the map!
*. The number of floors of the Tower of the Demon King has been added, and now you can challenge up to 2000 floors!
*. Added a time limit for battles. If a single battle lasts longer than 6 minutes and 30 seconds, the challenge will automatically fail;
*. Optimized the translation results of Chinese, Japanese and other languages;

2023.7.1 v0.3.4 update:
2023.6.30 v0.3.3 version update
2023.6.27 v0.3.2 version update content
Dear Demon Lords, the wait is finally over!
notes.content:
Here are the new updates and features in the latest version:

Added a new character: Leviathan
Introduced exclusive skills for equipment
Implemented equipment forging feature
Included the Tower of the Demon Lord and leaderboard
Introduced a brand new talent system
Added main storyline quests
Expanded the number of quests and rewards
In addition, we have also made the following additions and improvements:

Added a free refresh feature in the tavern (refreshes available every 10 minutes)
Included equipment categorization tabs
Implemented materials drop in normal stages
Introduced automatic equipment selling option on the settlement screen (can select the quality to automatically sell)
Continued the main storyline with additional content
Furthermore, we have addressed known bugs and optimized the pace of early game progression.

Thank you for your patience and support. We can't wait to meet you all on June 25th!
